newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-MAF Bancorp cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-MAF Bancorp cut to hold.

text.p: -- ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Thursday it downgraded MAF Bancorp Inc to hold from buy based solely on valuation.

-- The stock trades at 11.4 times ABN AMRO's 1997 earnings estimate and at 193 percent of tangible book value, ABN AMRO said. Prospects for further appreciation are not great enough to warrant a continued buy rating, ABN AMRO said.
-- ABN AMRO also said it is maintaining its earnings estimate of $3.50 for calendar 1997 and introducing an estimate of $3.50 for 1998.
-- MAF Bancorp is a bank holding company.
-- Its shares were trading down 1/4 Thursday at 39-1/2.
